question: How is combat damage assigned with multiple units per side?
assumptions: RiftJudge p1846 — abstract 'how is damage assigned in combat' question. The bridge auto-builds a minimal showdown and runs it through the engine: each side sums its total Might and deals it simultaneously to the other side, lethal-to-one-unit-before-the-next (rule 460.2.c.3).
